howto.text:
How to try them

Press Play on a phone. Each prototype runs the same flow:

1. Create identity: no phone, no email.
2. Chat: type and send; the paperclip sends a file.
3. The ⋯ menu: verify safety number, simulate an incoming call, burn identity. The lock icon also opens verify.

Tweaks: dark/light, accent, haptic labels.

On Android Chrome you feel real vibration and on iPhone a system tick, where the browser allows it inside this preview. Everywhere, the pill at the top names the haptic that just fired.

a.text:
A · Obsidian Glass
Dark-first, translucent depth, one electric accent. Quiet and premium.

Type: Geist + Geist Mono
Motion: 320 ms blur-fade, slow ambient light
Haptics: soft tick (send) · glass tap (receive) · deep thunk (verify) · ring pulse · rising ticks → shatter (burn)

b.text:
B · Swiss Mono
No bubbles. Strict grid, mono metadata, black/white + signal orange. Fast and plain-spoken.

Type: Inter Tight + JetBrains Mono
Motion: none, instant cuts
Haptics: one crisp click for everything · double click = success · bell = ring · a click every 10% while burning

c.text:
C · Soft Expressive
Tonal color, big radii, spring physics, shapes that morph when pressed. Friendly and alive.

Type: Figtree
Motion: overshoot springs (cubic-bezier .34, 1.56, .64, 1)
Haptics: pop (send) · bubble (receive) · boing (success) · hug (verify) · wobble (ring) · rumble → poof (burn)
